answer_1.quote: Given a user query, standing instructions, and API documentation, an agent must generate up to three API calls to fulfil the user request ... The interpretation subtask ... generation of API calls to perform the user task using the user query, user profile, and API documentation.
answer_1.outputs: API calls (function name, argument name, value) formatted as (function, slot, value) triplets

answer_2.quote: We convert each API call into (function name, argument name, value) triplets, or slots, to compute the metrics and report exact match (EM), slot-wise F1, precision, and recall.

answer_4.quote: We manually annotate a sample of 100 predictions for each model and perform their qualitative analysis. We classify the errors into several categories ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators examine each generated API call and assign it to predefined error categories such as semantic substitution errors, hallucinations, value formatting issues, and missing arguments.
